description:
A man who measures every relationship in terms of profit and loss meets a dancer who knows nothing but his art.
Their destructive love strips away their individuality and drags them into ruin—until, somehow, it leads them to a fractured kind of happy ending.

**Top: Kang Tae-eon (20s → 30s)**  
The third son of the Taesan Group and a strong candidate for the next heir. A tall and strikingly handsome man with a calculating and cynical nature. He trusts no one and has no qualms about using people as tools.

**Bottom: Lee Shin-woo (20s → 30s)**  
A ballet dancer, the embodiment of sensuality. Though his face is unremarkable in comparison, his body is so perfectly beautiful that it overshadows everything else. Quiet and even-tempered, he grew up practically an orphan, emotionally detached and resilient to pain.

**Original Novel:**  
Volumes: [RIDI](https://ridibooks.com/books/809036068), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/novel/E000089979), [Bookcube](https://www.bookcube.com/detail.asp?series_num=922007612)
